user.title: Xiaomi Smart Pet Fountain 2
user.description: Local connection to the fountain (xiaomi.pet_waterer.iv02). The token is the 32-character hexadecimal key of the device; see the README to get it.

data_description.host: Give the fountain a fixed IP address (DHCP reservation) on your router.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the fountain
reconfigure.description: Change the IP address or the token of this fountain.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from this address. Check the IP address and that the fountain is on the same network.
error.invalid_token: The fountain answers but rejects the token.
error.invalid_token_format: The token must be 32 hexadecimal characters.
error.unsupported_model: This device is not a Xiaomi Smart Pet Fountain 2 (xiaomi.pet_waterer.iv02).
error.cannot_identify: The device returned neither a MAC address nor a device ID.

abort.wrong_device: This address and token belong to another device.

init.title: Options

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two reads of the fountain.
data_description.preferred_mode: Mode written back by Keep mode. Choosing a mode with the mode entity also changes it.
data_description.restore_delay: Seconds to wait before writing the mode back (the fountain needs a moment after power returns).
data_description.force_mode: Also correct a mode changed from the device button or the Mi Home app, at every poll. Off: such changes are left alone until the next power cut.

init.description: The fountain forgets its mode when it loses mains power. With **Keep mode** on (switch of the device), the integration writes the preferred mode back after a delay: when mains power comes back, when the fountain answers again after being unavailable, and at startup.

entry_not_found.message: No Xiaomi Smart Pet Fountain 2 entry with ID {entry_id}.

no_preferred_mode.message: No preferred mode is known yet: choose a mode first.

restore_mode.name: Restore mode
restore_mode.description: Writes the preferred mode to the fountain now, whatever the Keep mode switch.

set_preferred_mode.name: Set preferred mode
set_preferred_mode.description: Changes the mode restored after power cuts, and restores it if Keep mode is on and the fountain is in another mode.
